findings.issue: Framework nomination inflation loses the replace/comparison polarity; this is a noninflationary alternative question, despite reheating appearing later.
findings.proposedRepair: Represent Galileon/NEC-violating background and alternative-to-inflation relation, preserving a primordial-perturbation bridge. Do not use inflation as an affirmative system membership.

findings.issue: The nominated slow_roll regime includes its violation rather than a globally valid slow-roll approximation.
findings.proposedRepair: Represent a temporal transition/violation target. Slow roll can remain a compared regime, not an everywhere-applicable premise.

findings.issue: The curved_field_space assumption mention omits the without-large qualifier. It must not become evidence that large curvature is required.
findings.proposedRepair: Keep the explicit negated/limited curvature condition and magnitude qualifier. No hard constraint from a positive lexical token.

findings.issue: An entirely unassigned unit explicitly describes entropy-mode amplification through field-dependent kinetic coupling.
findings.proposedRepair: Add proposed perturbation-amplification target and kinetic-coupling method, with stationary background chi scope. Its methodological navigation can cross physical backgrounds without merging questions.

findings.issue: An entirely unassigned unit has clear initial-state and preinflationary-background targets.
findings.proposedRepair: Add early-time radiation-era history and initial-state dependence of CMB power. Keep preinflation distinct from inflation dynamics and from late reheating.

literalSpan.text: decreasing, initially very large sound speed

findings.issue: The no-inflation polarity is retained, but there is no useful sound-speed/primordial-fluctuation bridge to other mechanisms.
findings.proposedRepair: Retain noninflationary expansion as its own scope and add comparison/method search on sound-speed evolution and scale-invariant perturbations; source review is needed before an admitted uses_method edge.

literalSpan.text: Could a varying L evade the constant-curvature restriction

findings.issue: The constant-curvature phrase names a restriction being challenged in an extension question, not necessarily a fixed premise of this whole facet.
findings.proposedRepair: Separate known constant-curvature setup from a varying-L extension target; record its interrogative scope and uncertainty. Reheating is a further target, not automatically the operative regime of the rapid-turn calculation.

findings.issue: Broad scalar-spectrum targets lose explicit branch alternatives and the varying-sound-speed organizing method.
findings.proposedRepair: Retain expanding/contracting as alternatives, with varying sound speed and stability comparisons. This offers an ordinary bridge to0803.0859 without asserting equal mechanisms or conclusions.

coverage: Eight explicit failure/omission findings selected from reading candidate factor descriptions; not an exhaustive scientific annotation of all87 units. Warm-PBH phase distinction additionally rests on the prior native source pilot.
conclusion: Typed navigation preserves useful distinctions but the lexical prototype cannot yet establish physical scope. Repair polarity, interrogative/comparison role, temporal phases and missing methods; use source-reviewed factors to reaggregate and overlap, never as universal cannot-link rules.
holdoutClaim: These controls are based on previously exposed admitted receipts and known development descriptions. No blind-source or population-generalization claim; no sealed24 source paper consumed.
